note: What a server sends to turn a unit to face a direction. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: towardX
fields.note: The direction faced, along one ground axis.

fields.name: towardZ
fields.note: The direction faced, along the other ground axis.

bits.name: turnOverTime
bits.note: Set to turn over turnTime, at least 0.0001 seconds; clear to face the direction at once, turnTime unread and the usual turn rate restored.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: turnTime
fields.note: How long the turn takes, in seconds.

bits.name: turnOverTime
bits.note: Set where the turn takes the time named below rather than happening at once. Clear in everything observed.

fields.note: The direction faced, along one ground axis.

fields.name: towardZ
fields.note: The direction faced, along the other ground axis.
